definitions.explanation: A painting executed on the panels of a {屏風|びょうぶ} (folding screen); a major format of traditional Japanese painting.

examples.japanese: ⟦{美術館|びじゅつかん}→美術館：01717_bijutsukan⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{屏風絵|びょうぶえ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}た→見る：00283_miru⟧。
examples.english: I saw a folding-screen painting at the museum.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧{屏風絵|びょうぶえ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{松|まつ}→松：02256_matsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{描|えが}かれている→描く：02013_egaku⟧。
examples.english: Pine trees are painted on this folding screen.

examples.japanese: ⟦{江戸|えど}{時代|じだい}→江戸時代：20431_edojidai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{屏風絵|びょうぶえ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{金箔|きんぱく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}った→使う：00473_tsukau⟧もの⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
examples.english: Many Edo-period folding-screen paintings use gold leaf.

notes:
A traditional painting format using the surface of a ⟦{屏風|びょうぶ}→屏風：06228_byoubu⟧; many famous works (e.g. {風神雷神図|ふうじんらいじんず}) are {屏風絵|びょうぶえ}.
